text_block_list.name: Event MC
text_block_list.text:
“—With that, we conclude the club team 
briefing by our representatives. We will 
now hold a Q&A session until the closing 
time—”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Dad's speech is over, so it's 
finally my turn!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, leave it to me! As a representative 
alumna of the racing club, I'll show them 
top-notch hospitality!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A kids' racing club run by Bubble Gum 
Fellow's father. Today, an information 
session was being held for those wishing 
to join the club.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to help her father even a little, 
Bubble Gum Fellow hurried to the event 
venue as an alumna representative.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look at all the kids out on the 
terrace. I'll head right over!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming to the event today! I'm 
the alumna Bubble Gum Fellow, nice to 
meetcha!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's the real Bubble-san! She's even 
cooler than on TV~!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Your racewear looks just like the one on 
TV...! Why are the sleeves all puffy? 
What's inside your pouch?"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No fair asking questions first! Why 
did you choose yellow? What are the 
patterns on the sleeves and legs!?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! You kids sure are lively~! All 
right, I'll tell you all about racing 
silks!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I chose yellow because it's so energetic! 
You can't get anything done without some 
energy, right?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The puffed cuffs and zigzag patterns were 
designed with explosions in mind. Dreams 
should be big and flashy, after all!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"And then... in the pouches on both my 
arms and waist――――ta-da!"

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Huh... Gum?!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, exactly! That's the source of my 
energy!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
From the right arm, the left arm, and the 
hips too! Look, look, looook~!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, they just keep coming! It's like a 
magic trick!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Now, put out your hands! I'll share some 
of my energy with everyone as a special 
treat!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Wah...! Thank you so much! Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-san is so amazing! Her running is 
so fast, and so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! Bubble-san is truly amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a wonderful smile! See? It 
cheers you right up, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's the design or the gum, I 
packed my racing outfit full of energy 
sources so I can go all out and pop off in 
the race!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
As the forerunner of the Big Four 
whirlwind— I'll create a massive explosion 
on the turf! Watch me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow declared boldly, dashed 
into an open space, and performed a light 
somersault. Her hair fluttered as she 
landed silently, flashing a grin.

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text: So cooool~!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! A-And that's that!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
If any girls want to follow in my 
footsteps, come join our club! I'll be 
waiting for you out on the turf!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Whew... It's over~!
choice_data_list: Good work! It was a huge success.
Great work! It was a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That's Dad for you. To think there'd 
be that many people wanting to join.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow smiled proudly. Handling 
that many people must have been tough, but 
her sense of accomplishment clearly 
outweighed any fatigue.
choice_data_list: You made the kids so happy, as expected.
Bubble's father looked so proud too

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah! Since you came all the way out 
here, I really wanted to make sure you had 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I can't even make the girl 
right in front of me happy, I'll never be 
able to stir up a Heavenly Kings 
whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That might indeed be the case. That 
explains why she handed out gum, did 
backflips, and put on such flashy 
performances.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So, here you go! Thanks for watching over 
me, Trainer! Take this energy boost!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We headed home together, blowing bubble 
gum along the way. The bubbles grew bigger 
and bigger until they popped with a 
satisfying snap—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?! What kind of face did they 
make?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told him that she'd occasionally look 
over at me and smile while answering 
questions from the parents. Bubble Gum 
Fellow's eyes lit up with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! He's a dad I'm really proud of, 
so, hehe, this feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
My actions and my race record reflect on 
my father's reputation. I'm proud of it, 
but I also feel the weight of that 
responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why I won't run 
away—I'll face it head-on! The whirlwind I 
kick up is gonna sweep up me, Dad, and 
everyone watching!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way she stated it so resolutely was 
refreshing enough to blow away even the 
heavy burden she must have been feeling.
